_comment: Template for hook_lint.py (v1.1). Scores 1-5. claim.status: verified|plausible|unverified|contested|false. claim_form: assertion (default) | question. A hook ASSERTION needs status=verified AND support_quote (<=15 words from that source) AND scope. gap_carrier: voice|frame|text|none. Use exactly 3 finalists with different mechanism, insight_key AND payoff_key.

candidates.hook_ar: ثقب صغير بورقة… والسطر المشوّش يصير واضح.
candidates.gloss_en: A small hole in a card and the blurred line becomes clear.
candidates.tension: Why does a small hole sharpen a blurred line?
candidates.first_frame: Blurred printed line on a desk; a black card with a ~1 mm hole slides in front of the lens; the line sharpens (filmed with a deliberately defocused lens; labelled as an optics demo)
candidates.continuation: The aperture blocks peripheral rays so the blur circle shrinks
candidates.payoff: Why it works, the trade-off (darker, narrower), and why clinics use ~1.2 mm occluders

claims.text: A ~1 mm aperture can make text blurred by refractive error look sharper
claims.support_quote: most useful pinhole diameter for clinical purposes is 1.2 millimeters
claims.scope: clinical occluder ~1.2 mm; adults without ocular disease; refractive errors up to +-5 D

beats.new_info: blurred line becomes readable through the card
beats.spoken: ثقب صغير بورقة… والسطر المشوّش يصير واضح.

beats.new_info: the same card without a hole does nothing; only the hole matters
beats.spoken: ليش؟ الورقة نفسها ما سوت شي.

beats.new_info: aperture blocks peripheral rays so the blur circle shrinks
beats.spoken: الثقب يوقّف الأشعة الجانبية، فالتشويش يصغر.

beats.new_info: too small a hole is darker and blurrier (diffraction); about 1 mm works best
beats.spoken: بس إذا صغّرته أكثر، يصير أغمق وأشوش.

beats.new_info: in clinics it is a clue under controlled conditions, not a self-test
beats.spoken: بالعيادة يستعملونه كمؤشر، مو فحص بالبيت.

candidates.risk: A camera's blur is defocus, not the viewer's eye
